title: Two Pieces of News
passage:
Here are two pieces of news that Andy collected for his school project.

Scientists in Hawaii developed a program to read information from tumor samples to better understand and treat cancer. The program, JAMMIT, uses math to understand patterns across different human cells and find out how to treat a cancer patient. As experts continue to develop learning programs for finding possible cures, there is no doubt that there will be a big rise in AI healthcare over the coming years.

Would you like to be as smart as a computer? A team of scientists has suggested using very tiny robots to create the Internet of Thoughts, where knowledge could be received just by thinking it. They suggest using these robots to create a direct line between the Internet and the brain to send messages in real time. This could then allow us to link the brain with AI and create a superbrain that would change human history. This shared computer could bring all groups together to form one truly global society. The project's greatest difficulty is to decide how to get these robots into the brain carefully and safely.
